summary: Iteration 3 testing of Pine Opti — reduced games to 4, REAL browser hardware scan, Windows services informational panel, security-status banner, auto-mode toggle, expanded fallback covering all 16 optimization categories. Backend: 18/18 new pytest passing (test_iteration3.py). Frontend: end-to-end UI flow passes — Inicio renders with real browser hardware (4C/8T x86, 8GB, SSD via Chromium WebGL), users counter shows 3 (not 7.7M), GameProfiles shows exactly 4 cards (Free Fire IGDB, CS2 Steam CDN 1920x natural width, Valorant IGDB, Fortnite IGDB) all with APLICAR PERFIL PERMANENTE button + anti-cheat tags, Optimización 'Servicios' subnav shows 12 protected service cards with [+] prefix + PROTEGIDO labels + Secure Boot/TPM 2.0 indicators at bottom, Seguridad tab has security-status banner ('SECURE BOOT · TPM 2.0 · 8 ANTI-CHEATS BLINDADOS · CERO MODIFICACIONES A SERVICIOS · CERO RIESGO DE BAN · CERO DAÑO A WINDOWS'), Configuración has prominent MODO AUTOMÁTICO PERMANENTE toggle that calls /api/auto-mode and toasts. All 16 optimization categories have items when clicked.

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from Recharts ResponsiveContainer — chart renders but parent container may briefly have 0 height on mount. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) Update /app/backend/tests/test_v2_features.py::TestGames to match the new 4-game contract, or delete that class since test_iteration3.py::TestGames4 fully covers it.

No required fixes — every spec item from the iteration 3 request is implemented and verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~822 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, games.py, optimize.py, services.py, dns.py, processes.py, achievements.py, scan.py) — the constants (GAME_PROFILES, WINDOWS_SERVICES, DNS_PRESETS, BLOAT_PROCESSES, ACHIEVEMENTS, NEWS, TOOLS, OPTIMIZATION_CATEGORIES, PROTECTED_SERVICES) and the giant _fallback_optimizations function (60+ items inline) are prime candidates for /app/backend/data/*.py extraction.
_parse_gpu/_parse_cpu live in server.py and use `import re` at function scope — move to /app/backend/lib/hardware_parse.py and import at module top.

/api/scan/browser still randomizes clock_ghz, temp_c, usage_pct, ram speed_mhz, network downlink calculation — clearly documented as mocked. Consider returning a `source: 'browser-real'|'browser-estimated'` tag per-field so the UI can show which numbers are real vs estimated.
/api/auto-mode just persists a boolean — no validation that the user has Pro / hardware compatible / hasn't been disabled by admin. Fine for personal app, but worth noting.

POST /api/games/{id}/apply, /api/dns/{id}/apply, /api/auto-mode, /api/theme, /api/processes/kill, /api/apply: bodies still typed as raw Dict[str, Any] — would benefit from dedicated Pydantic models for 422 validation responses (carried over from iteration 2).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (register, Inicio stats=3 with real browser hardware, 4-game GameProfiles with real cover images, Optimización Servicios subnav with 12 cards, Seguridad with security-status banner + anti-cheat panel, all 16 categories render items, Configuración MODO AUTOMÁTICO PERMANENTE toggles and toasts)
